faq_title_emote_commands: Why are my emote commands not working?
faq_content_emote_commands: Make sure to add the bot as a 7TV editor. If that's done, check if the bot has accepted your editor request. It may take a few minutes.
faq_title_rename_emote: How do I rename an emote?
faq_title_force_add: How do I force-add an emote (replace an existing emote)?
faq_content_force_add: There's no parameter to force-add as of right now, so you must remove it then add the new one.
blog_add_emotes_content:
To add a single emote:
add emote

To add a single emote to a specified channel:
add emote #channel

The command also allows for adding multiple emotes at once:
add emote1 emote2 emote3 #channel
blog_remove_emotes_content:
To remove a single emote:
remove emote

To remove a single emote from a specified channel:
remove emote #channel

To remove multiple emotes from a specified channel:
remove emote1 emote2 emote3 #channel
alert_editor_request: It may take a few minutes until the bot accepts your editor request!
index_content: Hashbot provides several commands to help you manage your 7TV emotes. Before starting to use emote management commands, make sure to add the bot as a 7TV editor by clicking your user picture > Settings > Editors > Add editor > hashtablebot.
